source.title: Forebears Senegal forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to replace the legacy name seed with localized samples.

source.title: ITU Senegal national numbering plan communication of 3.X.2023

phones.notes: ITU confirms country code +221 and nine-digit national significant numbers. Listed leading digits are public mobile-style allocations; generated numbers are synthetic and not checked for assignment or portability.

locations.notes: UPU confirms Senegal uses five-digit postcodes placed to the left of the delivery office name. City/street pairings and selected prefixes are synthetic review data, not delivery-validated addresses.

ecowas_id_card_number.label: ECOWAS ID Card Number

source.title: Senegal ECOWAS biometric identity card decree

ecowas_id_card_number.notes: The decree directly confirms a 17-digit card number and describes semantic components. Generated values intentionally use a plain random template; sex, region, date-of-birth, and sequence semantics are not implemented.

passport.label: Passport
passport.notes: PRADO confirms the ordinary passport document but no public passport-number grammar was found. The generated format remains an unconfirmed synthetic placeholder.
